title: Silicification immobilization microbial inoculant, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a silicification immobilization microbial inoculant, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: activating phenanthrene degradation bacterium GY2B in a phenanthrene-containing inorganic salt culture medium until the logarithmic growth later period; adding wood dust and a GY2B bacterium solution into the phenanthrene-containing inorganic salt culture medium, and carrying out shake culture in a shaking table until the stabilization period; discarding the supernatant, washing, and draining the immobilization carrier to obtain an immobilization microbial inoculant; transferring the immobilization microbial inoculant into a small culture dish by spreading a thin layer, putting the small culture dish at the center of a big culture dish to form an outer ring between the big and small culture dishes, putting a plurality of glass beads in the outer ring, and dropwisely adding 1mL of tetramethyl orthosilicate on the glass beads; and covering the big culture dish, sealing, incubating in a 30 DEG C incubator for 2 hours, taking out, cooling in a 4 DEG C refrigerator, and collecting the immobilization microbial inoculant which is the silicification immobilization microbial inoculant. The microbial inoculant has favorable stability, and can accelerate the restoration and recovery.
